units.source_text: 且说葵姬被魂灵附体，病势转剧，非常痛苦。

en.t: Now Lady Aoi was possessed by a spirit, and as her illness grew worse, she suffered terribly.

units.source_text: 世人纷纷传说：此乃六条妃子自己的生灵及其已故父大臣的鬼魂作怪。

en.t: People everywhere said that this was the work of Lady Rokujo's own living spirit, together with the ghost of her late father, the minister.

units.source_text: 六条妃子闻知此事，思虑满腹。

en.t: When Lady Rokujo heard of this, her heart was filled with anxious thoughts.

units.source_text: 她推想：“我只痛惜自身，并不怨恨他人。

en.t: She thought to herself, "I only grieve for my own fate; I bear no resentment toward anyone else.

units.source_text: 但闻过于忧郁，灵魂自会脱却身体而浮游出外，为人作怪，此事庸或有之。”

en.t: Yet I have heard that when sorrow becomes too deep, the soul may leave the body of its own accord, drift outside, and trouble others; perhaps such a thing can happen."

units.source_text: 近年来她为种种事情悲伤忧恼，然而从未像此次之心碎肠断。

en.t: In recent years she had grieved and suffered over many things, but never had she been as heartbroken as she was now.

units.source_text: 自从祓禊那天为争夺车位而被人蔑视、身受奇耻大辱以来，

en.t: Ever since the day of the purification, when she was scorned in the struggle over carriage places and suffered a humiliating insult,

units.source_text: 一味忧伤悔恨之余，心灵往往浮游飘荡，不能安静。

en.t: she had been consumed by sorrow and regret, and her spirit often seemed to drift restlessly, unable to be still.

units.source_text: 因此每逢迷离入梦之时，便神游于某处洞房清宫，

en.t: For this reason, whenever she slipped dimly into dreams, her spirit would wander to some secluded, elegant chamber,

units.source_text: 仿佛是葵姬之家，就同此人纠缠不清。

en.t: which seemed to be Lady Aoi's house, and there she became entangled with that woman and could not break away.

units.source_text: 此时她的性行与醒时完全不同：

en.t: At such times her nature was completely different from when she was awake:

units.source_text: 凶猛暴戾，只顾向此人袭击。

en.t: fierce and violent, she thought only of attacking that woman.

units.source_text: 这是近来屡有之事。

en.t: This had happened repeatedly of late.

units.source_text: 她常常想：“唉，惭愧！

en.t: She often thought, "Ah, how shameful!

units.source_text: 难道我的灵魂真会出窍，往葵姬那里去么？”

en.t: Can my soul truly be leaving my body and going to Lady Aoi?"

units.source_text: 觉得非出本心，甚是奇怪。

en.t: It seemed not to come from her true will, and she found it deeply strange.

units.source_text: 她又想：“些些小事，世人都要说短道长，

en.t: She also thought, "People gossip over even the smallest matters,

units.source_text: 何况像我这种行径，正是教人宣扬恶名的好把柄了。”

en.t: so conduct like mine gives them the perfect excuse to spread my disgrace."

units.source_text: 她痛惜声名，反复思量：“倘是已死之人，怨魂不散，为人作祟，乃世间常有之事。

en.t: Grieving over her reputation, she thought again and again, "When a dead person's resentful spirit lingers and haunts the living, that is common enough in the world.

units.source_text: 但即使他人有此等事，我也认为罪过深重，可憎可恶。

en.t: Yet even when it happens to someone else, I consider it a grave sin, hateful and abhorrent.

units.source_text: 何况我现在活着，被人如此宣扬恶名，真乃前世作孽！

en.t: How much worse, then, that while I am still alive, people should spread such shameful rumors about me; this must be karma from a former life!

units.source_text: 这都是我爱上了那个薄情人之故。

en.t: All of this is because I fell in love with that heartless man.

units.source_text: 自今以往，决不再想他了。”

en.t: From now on, I will never think of him again."

units.source_text: 虽然如此，正如古语所说：“想不想时已是想。

en.t: Even so, as the old saying goes, "When you think that you will not think of someone, you are already thinking of them.

units.source_text: 何不连不想也不想？”

en.t: Why not stop thinking even about not thinking?"
